description: This file contains Python code implementing utility functions and classes for preparing, downloading, unpacking, and managing requirements and distributions as part of the pip package management system. It handles fetching files from URLs or VCS, verifying hashes, unpacking archives, and preparing distribution metadata.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A simple class representing a downloadable file with its path and content type.

RequirementPreparer.description: A class responsible for preparing requirements, handling download, unpacking, metadata extraction, and other preparatory steps for pip installations.

methods.description: Unpacks a version control system link into a specified location.

methods.description: Downloads a file from an HTTP URL, returning a File object.

methods.name: File get_file_url( link: Link, download_dir: Optional[str] = None, hashes: Optional[Hashes] = None )
methods.description: Returns a File object for a local or cached file URL.

methods.description: Downloads and unpacks a URL-based requirement, handling VCS, file, and HTTP links.
